title: IVFN Subtraction (Interval Calculus) — subtract_ivfn
text: subtracts one Interval-Value Fuzzy Number (IVFN) another via interval calculus. IVFN represented interval X: $$X\  =( x_{1}, x_{2}) \ =\ [ x_{1} ;x_{2}] =\{x\\mathbb{R} \ |\ x_{1} \ \leq x\ \leq x_{2}\}$$ \(x_1\) \(x_2\) represent lower upper bounds, respectively. IVFN X may another IVFN Y subtracted via: $$X\ -\ Y\ =\ [ x_{1} \ -\ y_{2} ;\ x_{2} \ -\ y_{1}]$$

title: TFN Subtraction (Interval Calculus) — subtract_tfn
text: subtracts one Triangular Fuzzy Number (TFN) another via interval calculus. TFN represented fuzzy set (triangular distribution): $$X\  =( x_{1} ,x_{2} ,x_{3}) \ =\ \left\{\begin{matrix} 0 & \  & x< x_{1}\\ \frac{2( x\ -\ x_{1})}{( x_{3} -x_{1})( x_{2} -x_{1})} & \  & x_{1} \leq x< x_{3} \ \\ \frac{2}{x_{3} -x_{1}} & & x\ =\ x_{2}\\ \frac{2( x_{3} -x)}{( x_{3} -x_{1})( x_{3} -x_{2})} & \  & x_{2} < x\leq x_{3}\\ 0 & & x >x_{3} \end{matrix}\right.$$ \(x_1\) \(x_3\) lower upper bounds, respectively, \(x_2\) mode. TFN X may another TFN Y subtracted via: $$X\ -\ Y\ =\ ( x_{1} -y_{3} ,\ x_{2} -y_{2} ,\ x_{3} -y_{1})$$
